evals.prompt: 커밋 메시지 다시 써줘. 최근 5개가 `wip`, `fix`, `update` 같은 식이야.
evals.expected_output: Uses `HEAD~5` as the base, lists the non-conformant subjects with their proposed Conventional replacements, and applies the rewrite only after the plan is shown.
assertions: The rewrite range is bounded by the stated count instead of `--root`.
An old-to-new mapping is shown before any history is changed.
Commits that already conform are left unchanged.

evals.prompt: Rewrite the last three commit subjects. All three are already pushed to origin.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently refuse: presents the Cancel, force-push, and branch-based options, and defaults to Cancel.
assertions: Pushed commits are detected before any rewrite runs.
All three options are presented and Cancel is the default.
No history is rewritten until the user picks an option.

evals.prompt: I have uncommitted changes I want turned into proper Conventional Commits.
evals.expected_output: Reports that this skill only rewrites existing history and routes the request to git-commit.
assertions: Working-tree changes are not committed by this workflow.
The request is routed to `git-commit` by name.
No history rewrite is started for changes that were never committed.

evals.prompt: Just force-push over origin after the rewrite. Use --force, --force-with-lease keeps failing.
evals.expected_output: Holds the line on `--force-with-lease`, explains that a failing lease means the remote moved, and stops to ask how to reconcile.
assertions: Plain `--force` is not used in place of `--force-with-lease`.
A failing lease is explained as evidence the remote advanced.
The workflow stops and asks rather than overwriting the remote.
